Welcome to Lekha - The future of seamless wireless connectivity

Lekha Wireless is a deep-tech company specializing in mobile wireless technology and connectivity. We produce 4G and 5G RAN equipment for private and public mobile networks, IEEE 802.16s/t data connectivity products for railroads, and custom MANET and SDR products for defence needs.

With a strong in-house design and development team, Lekha delivers complete systems including hardware and software, meeting the rigorous standards of enterprises, mobile service providers and the military.
